WhatTheRack and WhatTheMod share one Module class and differ only in their widget, so the Randomize Parameters setting is stored in the same place for both.

The counts in the lines are the literal arguments to SpawnAFewModels in src/WhatTheRackModule.cpp: 2 VCOs, 2 LFOs, 2 VCAs, 1 sequencer, 1 clock, 3 effects, 2 filters, 2 envelopes, 3 miscellaneous, 1 mixer, and up to 10 from a "basics" list which in practice holds only Core's AudioInterface and Fundamental's Scope. That is 19 plus those two, which is what the README says. If a category has no installed modules with the right tag, fewer arrive.

The category lists are built once in the module's constructor, so a plugin installed after the module was placed is not seen until the module is placed again.

Nothing on this module can be clicked for help. There are no parameters, no inputs and no outputs, and the question mark is a CallbackButton (an SvgButton subclass) with no ParamWidget, so the census has empty position lists. The entry is all Note lines and one Menu line, which is what a module with no controls has to be.

The maker's own README warns that the plugin is doing something the Rack APIs do not encourage and that he is not certain it cannot crash Rack.
